chunks: In another narration, he said: “A pomegranate stick is to be used in its place.”
Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, said: Nothing from the shrouds of the deceased should be cut with iron, and fire should not be brought near, whether by incense or anything else.
The compiler of this book said: We heard that in discussion from the shaykhs, may Allah have mercy on them, and this was their practice.

key_terms.عُودُ الرُّمَّانِ: a pomegranate stick used as a substitute mentioned in the report

ai.seo_question: What are the rulings on cutting the deceased’s shroud and bringing fire or incense near the deceased in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This passage mentions a substituted implement in another narration, then records a legal ruling concerning the shrouding of the deceased. It states that nothing from the deceased’s shrouds should be cut with iron and that fire should not be brought near the deceased by incense or otherwise, noting that this was transmitted in scholarly discussion and acted upon by the shaykhs.
